content.short: ADAPunks are decentralised community NFT collection of 10K with unique traits and attributes inspired by the Cardano ecosystem.
content.description:
ADAPunks are a collection of 10K procedurally-generated CNFTs with a complete redesign and restructuring of unique traits and attributes inspired by the Cardano ecosystem and universe.

We are a decentralised community of Punkz.

We believe the power of the Cryptopunk movement taps into a greater brilliance of understanding a path forward into the world of web 3.0, blockchain and decentralisation. The ability to create an identity through an NFT and enter into an online network that prospers with love, unity, kindness and friendship is a wonderful thing. These are revolutionary ideas, to retain accessible forms of privacy and anonymity whilst being able to access fundamental identity and financial systems that allow societies to prosper.

What better place to host a decentralised community of likeminded people than on the Cardano blockchain.

As we enter the depths of the Goguen era and beyond, and we progress through the epochs of Cardano, hard fork events will come and go - this community will grow with them while expanding and utilising the true potential of decentralisation together. That's community tools, voting, stake pool funding and more.

We are not affiliated with Larva Labs, we just love and respect the ideas and philosophy behind the movement they created, with intention to further cement and clarify their validity and pioneering ideas in a creative and community driven, decentralised way. ADAPunkz parodies and explores art subculture in a respectful and honorific manner on the most punk blockchain in existence.

We are the rats.
